description: Flammability test per BS 5722 - specimens must self-extinguish within 60 seconds
Size labels and care instructions must be in English
Flammability test per EN 71-2 - minimum performance requirements
Chemical testing for restricted substances per OEKO-TEX standard
Stainless steel 18/8 grade minimum for food contact surfaces
Leaching test for heavy metals - lead and cadmium limits
Food contact statement required on labelling
CPNP (Cosmetics Products Notification Portal) registration required
Safety assessment and stability testing required
UK registration and safety data required
PFAS content must be below 100 ppm
